sectionHeights.description: Rendered heights at 1440px of the built clone (vite build + vite preview), written by extraction/measure_sections.mjs from extraction/measure-recipes.json. routes: per route the page height and every measured section instance; in-flow instances tile the document (each runs from its start to the next start, margins included, so they sum to pageHeightPx); out-of-flow instances (fixed/absolute chrome and runtime overlays opened by recipe steps) take no page height. sections: per section the tallest instance. Read by extraction/wrapper_gate.py.

wrapperGateDecomposition.description: Why legal.document-body was split in 1.2.0. Computed from the same 1440px measurement in sectionHeights: the former body section is the sum of today's preamble + section instances. It exceeded the 60% page-share failure threshold of extraction/wrapper_gate.py on both legal routes, so it was decomposed along the real H2 boundaries of src/pages/Privacy.jsx and src/pages/Terms.jsx instead of being whitelisted.
